meta: Make English news easier to read: ask AI to rewrite it at your level instead of looking up a word on every line.

muc.title: A dictionary for every line
muc.text: Reading English news and looking up words on every line is discouraging. AI can rewrite the article at your level.

muc.title: Easier, nothing missing
muc.text: Paste a paragraph, tell AI your level, and ask it to rewrite it with easier words while keeping every point.

muc.title: Easy first, original second
muc.text: Read the easy version first, then the original. You'll guess many words without looking them up.

muc.title: Learn only five words
muc.text: At the end, ask AI to choose just the five words most worth learning, with meanings and an example sentence.

muc.title: A paragraph of today's news
muc.text: Paste a paragraph of English news into a chatbot, ask for an easy version, then read both.

thu: Paste a paragraph of English news into a chatbot, ask for an easy version, then read both.
